title: PR #44254 — perps order book on the order entry page
description: Proves the TAT-3309 acceptance criteria for the perps order-book panel: collapsed by default, expandable by click, feature-flag gated, price levels + USD totals on both sides, responsive split layout, and no regression to the existing order form fields.

setup-status.intent: Resolve the Extension checkout and adapter status before order-book proof

setup-cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Ensure the wallet is unlocked before opening the perps order entry page

setup-open-perps.intent: Leave any previously mounted order entry page so the order book starts from its default state

ac1-navigate-order-entry.intent: AC1: open the perps order entry page for ETH

ac1-wait-order-entry-page.intent: AC1: confirm the order entry page is mounted

ac1-wait-toggle-affordance.intent: AC1: confirm the order-book expand affordance is present in the market header

ac1-assert-book-collapsed.intent: AC1: assert the order-book panel is NOT rendered on arrival (collapsed by default)

ac1-assert-divider-collapsed.intent: AC1: assert the resize divider is absent while the panel is collapsed

ac1-screenshot-collapsed-by-default.intent: AC1: capture the default collapsed state of the order entry page
ac1-screenshot-collapsed-by-default.label: AC1: order entry page on arrival — order form fills the width, no order-book panel, only the collapsed toggle in the header.

ac2-press-toggle.intent: AC2: click the order-book toggle in the market header to expand the panel

ac2-wait-panel-visible.intent: AC2: confirm the order-book panel mounted after the click

ac2-wait-divider-visible.intent: AC2: confirm the resizable split divider appeared with the expanded panel

ac2-wait-ladder-rows.intent: AC2: wait for the full live ask ladder (5 levels) so the panel shows real book depth, not a skeleton

ac2-wait-depth-ratio.intent: AC2: confirm the buy/sell depth ratio rendered under the ladder

ac2-screenshot-expanded-order-book.intent: AC2: capture the expanded order book as the result of the click
ac2-screenshot-expanded-order-book.label: AC2: after clicking the header toggle — the order-book panel is expanded beside the form, showing asks, spread, bids and the buy/sell depth ratio.

ac4-wait-ask-price.intent: AC4: confirm the ask side renders a price level

ac4-wait-ask-value.intent: AC4: confirm the ask side renders its USD total value column

ac4-wait-bid-price.intent: AC4: confirm the bid side renders a price level

ac4-wait-bid-value.intent: AC4: confirm the bid side renders its USD total value column

ac4-assert-usd-total-header.intent: AC4: assert the value column is explicitly labelled as a USD total

ac4-screenshot-price-levels-usd-totals.intent: AC4: capture price levels and USD totals for both asks and bids
ac4-screenshot-price-levels-usd-totals.label: AC4: ladder with the 'Price / Total (USD)' column headers — five ask price levels above the spread and five bid price levels below, each with a USD cumulative total.

ac3-run-flag-off-hides-toggle-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.test.tsx --no-coverage -t "does not render the order book toggle when the feature flag is off" 2>&1
ac3-run-flag-off-hides-toggle-test.intent: AC3: exercise the flag-OFF render path, unreachable in the live slot (the running fixture pins perpsOrderBookEnabled to enabled:true and remote flags are not writable read-only)

ac3-assert-flag-off-exit.intent: AC3: the flag-OFF suite run must succeed

ac3-assert-flag-off-test-passed.intent: AC3: prove that named flag-OFF test actually matched and PASSED (a non-existent title yields 0 passed at exit 0, so this discriminates)

ac3-run-flag-selector-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/selectors/perps/feature-flags.test.ts --no-coverage -t "returns false when the perpsOrderBookEnabled flag is absent" 2>&1
ac3-run-flag-selector-test.intent: AC3: prove the gate defaults to OFF when the remote flag is absent entirely (jest -t is a regex, so the title is matched without its parenthesised suffix)

ac3-assert-flag-selector-exit.intent: AC3: the selector default-OFF run must succeed

ac3-assert-flag-selector-passed.intent: AC3: prove the getIsPerpsOrderBookEnabled default-OFF assertion matched and PASSED

ac5-run-narrow-body-clamp-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/order-book/order-book.utils.test.ts --no-coverage -t "caps the width so the form keeps its pixel floor on a narrow body" 2>&1
ac5-run-narrow-body-clamp-test.intent: AC5: exercise the compact-layout width clamp that keeps the form usable in the ~360px popup, which this CDP session cannot reach visually (no popup target exposed)

ac5-assert-narrow-body-exit.intent: AC5: the narrow-body clamp run must succeed

ac5-assert-narrow-body-passed.intent: AC5: prove the narrow-body clamp assertion matched and PASSED

ac5-run-popup-ceiling-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/order-book/order-book.utils.test.ts --no-coverage -t "returns the pixel-aware ceiling on a narrow popup body" 2>&1
ac5-run-popup-ceiling-test.intent: AC5: exercise the popup-width ceiling derivation that drives aria-valuemax and the clamp on a compact body

ac5-assert-popup-ceiling-exit.intent: AC5: the popup-ceiling run must succeed

ac5-assert-popup-ceiling-passed.intent: AC5: prove the popup-ceiling assertion matched and PASSED

ac5-screenshot-fullscreen-split-layout.intent: AC5: capture the expanded/fullscreen half of the responsive split
ac5-screenshot-fullscreen-split-layout.label: AC5 (expanded/fullscreen half only): form and order book share the width via the draggable divider in the fullscreen (home.html) layout. This image does NOT prove the compact popup layout — no popup target is reachable from this CDP session; the compact path is covered by the ac5-* clamp assertions instead.

ac6-press-bid-price-row.intent: AC6: tap a bid price row — the highest-risk interaction between the new panel and the existing order form

ac6-wait-limit-price-field.intent: AC6: confirm the limit price field is present and usable after the order type switched to Limit

ac6-wait-order-type-toggle.intent: AC6: confirm the Market/Limit order-type control still renders

ac6-wait-amount-field.intent: AC6: confirm the size/amount field still renders beside the open order book

ac6-wait-leverage-control.intent: AC6: confirm the leverage control still renders

ac6-wait-auto-close-tpsl.intent: AC6: confirm the TP/SL (auto-close) control still renders

ac6-wait-submit-button.intent: AC6: confirm the submit control still renders with the order book open

ac6-screenshot-form-fields-intact.intent: AC6: capture the order form intact after the order-book interaction
ac6-screenshot-form-fields-intact.label: AC6: after tapping a bid price, the form shows Limit selected with the tapped price prefilled, and size, leverage, TP/SL (auto-close) and submit all still render beside the open order book.

ac6-run-order-form-regression-tests.intent: AC6: run the existing order-form hook suites that own limit price, size and leverage state

ac6-assert-order-form-exit.intent: AC6: the pre-existing order-form suites must still pass with the prefill wiring added

ac6-assert-order-form-suites-passed.intent: AC6: prove both pre-existing order-form hook suites actually ran and passed, not just that the process exited 0

teardown-collapse-order-book.intent: Collapse the order book so the slot is left in its default state

teardown-return-perps-home.intent: Return the slot to the perps home surface
